pattern: I am / You are / He is / She is / It is
example: I am a student.
mistake: Using do with BE: "I do am a student"

pattern: I / you / he / she / it / we / they
example: She is my friend.
mistake: Mixing subject and object: "Him is my friend"

pattern: my / your / his / her / its / our / their
example: This is my mother.
mistake: Using he's for his: "This is he book"
drill: Label 15 things in a family photo

pattern: this + singular near, that + singular far, these/those + plural
example: This is my pen. Those are her shoes.
mistake: these is / that are

pattern: There is + singular, There are + plural
example: There are two books on the table.
mistake: Using is with a plural: "There is two books"

pattern: What / Where / Who / When / Why / How + BE or DO
example: Where are you from?
mistake: Wrong auxiliary or missing BE: "Where you from?"

pattern: S + V(s/es); negative don't / doesn't
example: She works every day.
mistake: Forgetting the -s: "She work every day"

pattern: be + V-ing
example: I am studying now.
mistake: Using present simple for right now: "I study now"

pattern: S + V2; negative did not + V
example: I visited Hue last week.
mistake: Double past marking: "I didn't went"

pattern: be + going to + V
example: I am going to study tonight.
mistake: Missing BE: "I going to study"

pattern: can + V (no to, no -s)
example: She can swim, but she can't drive.
mistake: Adding to: "She can to swim"

pattern: some / any / much / many / a few / a little
example: I need some water and a few apples.
mistake: many water / much books
drill: Sort 30 nouns and write 10 shopping lines

pattern: -er / more + adj; the -est / the most
example: This phone is cheaper than that one.
mistake: more + -er: "more cheaper"

pattern: have / has + V3; ever / never / since / for
example: I have never been to Japan.
mistake: Using a finished time: "I have been there last year"

pattern: was / were + V-ing
example: I was cooking when she called.
mistake: Using it for a completed action: "I was finished"

pattern: will + V (decision now), be going to + V (plan)
example: I'll help you. / I'm going to move next month.
mistake: will + to: "I will to go"

pattern: If + present simple, will + V
example: If it rains, I will stay home.
mistake: will inside the if-clause: "If it will rain"

pattern: should / must / have to / might + V
example: You should sleep more. You must wear a helmet.
mistake: should to / must to
drill: Give 10 pieces of advice and 10 rules

pattern: be + V3 (present and past)
example: The product is made in Vietnam.
mistake: Wrong BE form: "The product made in Vietnam"
drill: Explain a process in 10 passive lines

pattern: because / so / although / but
example: I was tired, but I finished my homework.
mistake: because + so in one sentence

pattern: who (people) / which (things) / that / where (places)
example: The app that I use is free.
mistake: Double subject: "The man who he called me"

pattern: said / told + clause, one tense back
example: She said she was tired.
mistake: Forgetting the backshift or the pronoun change

pattern: If + past simple, would + V
example: If I had more time, I would travel.
mistake: would inside the if-clause

pattern: like / enjoy + V-ing, want / decide + to V
example: I enjoy studying, and I want to improve.
mistake: want studying / enjoy to study

pattern: first of all / however / in addition / to sum up
example: First of all, let me explain the problem.
mistake: Listing ideas with no connectors at all
